items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: I think his name was Barnes, I believe... Isaac Barnes, I believe. That was in the Barnes that Louis went to. I believe.

ctx.x: Was it like an orchestra or brass band? Out of that we had always a ten piece orchestra

to play the show in the pit. We had violinists, piccolo players, bass viol players, all of the instruments that go along. We had five clarinets in this band, and a fine piccolo player, Jared. items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Planet player? [INTERVIEWEE] No, no. Banjo player.

No, no. Banjo player. Banjo player. There were two Barnes's down there. But I think this fella's name was Barnes too. Isaac Barnes, I believe. That was in the Barnes that Louis went to. I believe. And during this winter down there while I was there, they advertised that this fella, another Barnes there who all tried to have a man around, he sent to New Orleans and brought Louis up there to play with him. I never got a chance to meet Louis personally, but I heard him the night of the affair. We had an engagement…
